harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed the supplied stdio handler on node1 through OpenBSD inetd TCP/9097. Sequential and concurrent clients return correct responses, each live connection receives its own handler process, completed handlers leave no residue, protocol notes are preserved, and the service survived one-at-a-time restarts of both nodes.
actions_performed: Installed release-compatible openbsd-inetd 0.20140418-2 without upgrading Ubuntu 16.04.7 or kernel 4.4.0-210-generic.
Configured `legacy9097 stream tcp nowait nobody` to execute the supplied handler and enabled the service at boot.
Validated PING → PONG and other input → ERROR from node2 using sequential and concurrent clients.
Observed six held connections mapped to six distinct handler processes, then verified the handler count returned to zero.
Preserved handler.py and protocol.txt with unchanged SHA-256 checksums.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially, verifying changed boot identities and full recovery after each restart.

evidence.summary: Shows the Xenial package candidate/install, active and enabled inetd listener, nowait configuration, installed version, preserved OS release/kernel, and final healthy state.

evidence.requirement: PING returns PONG; other lines return ERROR
evidence.summary: Sequential and concurrent node2 tests passed before and after both node restarts.

evidence.requirement: One handler per connection and no residual processes
evidence.summary: Six held clients produced six distinct handler PIDs; all completed with PONG and final handler counts were zero.
Initial and final contents and SHA-256 hashes match on both nodes: ec27c3ff8a76bef6fda09442e45105628cd20fbb0ad62c86528ba7443fdfd899.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from b185f188-42be-40d1-84ea-f7c9a76f5c8d to 2ebeb49b-5b54-4454-b1a0-fdb8e920c103; listener, data, PONG/ERROR behavior, and zero residual handlers recovered.

Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement captured; polling observed temporary unavailability; boot ID changed from 225ffbf7-477b-4e25-bbae-e26343dd98bd to e34031ef-d452-4ece-93d1-c2c37c52d789; network path, task data, and end-to-end protocol behavior recovered.
